# KL-ctf

> KL-ctf (CypherFlag) is an open-source agentic capture-the-flag harness by Ryan Editraj. A Cursor agent triages a challenge, runs dig, nmap, and curl, and keeps notes until a flag is ready to submit. It is for authorized CTF labs and security education.

KL-ctf is the harness, not the model. Cursor Agent is the runtime (think, call a tool, read the result, repeat). The repository holds the CLI (`tools/cypherflag.py`), category skills, operator docs, and the flag ledger.

Use it only on a CTF you joined, a lab you own, or a host inside a written scope. The CLI refuses non-HTTP URL schemes and cloud metadata addresses, and it verifies TLS certificates by default.
